title: Farm in a Box: Grow More with Less

authority.boundary: The brief controls the design challenge and evidence purpose. It does not approve a crop, site, container, growing medium, tool, chemical, process or local safety control.

situation: Useful agriculture can happen in a small space. The challenge is to create a compact crop-production system that makes careful use of water and other resources, can be monitored with simple records, and can be improved when conditions change.
brief: Design, establish, monitor, improve and evaluate a portable Farm in a Box crop-production system using the crop, location, materials, tools and processes approved by your teacher. Use evidence to show how the system supports plant growth, manages resources and could be improved for another growing cycle.
must_include: a clearly defined need, intended users and measurable success criteria
research into the selected crop and its growing requirements
at least two genuinely different annotated design ideas
a justified final design and production plan
a field record containing dates, observations, measurements and decisions
at least one evidence-based test or modification
a final judgement against the criteria and a specific next-version proposal
fixed_boundaries: The course runs for 25 x 60-minute periods across approximately 10 weeks.
Manual observations and measurements are sufficient; sensors are optional enrichment.
The harvested material can be measured, graded and photographed without being eaten.
Crop failure, delayed growth or disrupted access becomes evidence for diagnosis and redesign; it does not automatically mean project failure.
Animals, aquaponics, permanent structures, mains-powered systems, pesticides and fertiliser instructions are not assumed by this brief.

success_criteria.criterion: The system performs its intended crop-support function under the available conditions.
Resource choices are justified and avoid unnecessary water, material and crop waste.
evidence_examples: reused or responsibly selected component rationale

success_criteria.criterion: The approved project is produced and maintained using the teacher's current local controls.
The system can be monitored and maintained within the available time, location and care arrangements.
evidence_examples: weekend or absence contingency supplied by the teacher

success_criteria.criterion: Design and production decisions are communicated clearly with relevant evidence.
Testing leads to a specific, evidence-based improvement or next-version proposal.

teacher_confirmation_required: approved crop or supplied fallback specimen/data
growing location, light, water access, security and holiday care
container, growing medium, wick or water-delivery components and budget
approved tools, processes, PPE, warnings, SDS/SOP and local risk controls
group size, roles, accessibility adjustments and individual evidence expectations
whether produce is only measured or may be consumed under separate food-safety and allergy controls
formal assessment status and any notification, weighting, due date or submission requirement

student_presentation.display: Complete on-page brief with printable view and accessible heading structure
student_presentation.download: Not required; the public HTML brief is the canonical student version

privacy: No student names, photographs, accounts or personal records are required by the brief.
